contradictions.reason: Completion is not interrupt-only, and scheduling precedes the prior transfer callback. The corresponding supersessions resolve both upstream inaccuracies.

Polling enable performs the command-submission write, not the claimed channel-status reset. Transfer-complete acknowledgement is distinct from callback-dependent interrupt masking; transfer callbacks do not receive the interrupt identifier.

The document correctly distinguishes this from the polling registry's separate full-table duplicate scan.
